principles.rule: Balance means diverse strategically viable competitive choices, not numerical equality. Temporary leadership and TL/context swings are allowed; persistent dominance/obsolescence are failures.
Never optimize K-PDS, E-PDS and AMM toward 50% at every TL or minimize inter-family win-rate variance as a global objective.
Preserve the intentional lopsided GP/Swarmer threat against ships that decline PDS; PDS buys counterplay rather than erasing missile identity.
K-PDS = sustained/simple kinetic defense; E-PDS = TP-flexible RC with Strain-producing overcharge and safe maturation; AMM = finite specialized interceptor with unique RC3 range-1 window.
Energy Low conserves TP / supports main-as-PDS reserve, Standard is routine, Overload is reserved Strain-consuming burst; K and Missile mains do not receive generic offensive overload.
Select technology-valid whole-TL ladders. Capability cannot regress without explicit rationale; quiet TLs and leapfrogging are allowed.
Use Pareto/viability and sensitivity/interaction evidence; do not collapse design quality to one outcome metric.

A closed response surface may be reopened only if a later mechanics/economic change is shown to materially invalidate the prior environment. The reopening checkpoint must cite that dependency break explicitly.
Research candidates remain separate from numerical authority until an explicit promotion checkpoint reconciles dependencies and updates authority files.
K/AMM ammunition is primarily endurance/logistics, not a fine per-TL balance knob. K should support several ordinary combats; AMM may exhaust in a single extended missile-heavy combat.
Final Reactor/TP supply tuning occurs only after main, defense and AUX demand surfaces are stabilized.
Player-facing mechanics stay KISS; the research engine may use broad multivariate statistics, interactions and Pareto analysis.

Every post-CP157 substantive balance study must load CP157-PF1 (or an explicitly superseding pending-finalization research baseline) through the canonical research baseline loader. Raw production v0.9 is historical/control only.

A substantive study must fail preflight if any field governed by the pending-finalization baseline silently falls back to an older production or checkpoint value. Any intentional exception must be named as a controlled alternate with provenance.

Pending-finalization promotion changes research execution authority, not final production authority. Selected values are the default for future studies until explicitly superseded; viable alternatives remain preserved.

failureConditions: family persistently dominated across TL/context space
provisional candidate silently written to authority
future pass changes a frozen dependency without declaring the invalidation
substantive pass loads raw v0.9 instead of current research execution baseline
pending-finalization field silently falls back to stale value
selected research baseline changed without explicit supersession/provenance
